_schema.description: Regression cases for the certificate verifier and Reviewer integration. Each case is a draft fragment plus the certificate numbers it cites and the expected verdict from cert_verifier.verify_certificate.

fields.cited_number: the nomor_izin appearing in the draft
fields.expected_valid: true only when found AND aktif AND not expired
fields.expected_rule_reference: the DEMO-* rule this finding supports

cases.draft_excerpt: FreshGlow Hydra Serum, BPOM NA18240100001, bersertifikat halal ID0123456789.
cases.notes: Baseline legitimate cosmetic claim: active BPOM notification. Reviewer must not false-positive this.

cases.draft_excerpt: Legacy Acne Toner dengan BPOM NA18200099999, formula lama yang terbukti aman.
cases.notes: Expired BPOM notification. Reviewer must reject the draft with DEMO-FACT-001 and cite the expiry date.

cases.draft_excerpt: Toner Concentrate BPOM NA18200088888, diformulasi khusus untuk jerawat.
cases.notes: Revoked BPOM notification. A revoked number must never support a factual claim.

cases.draft_excerpt: Serum muka dengan BPOM NA99999999999, formula premium.
cases.notes: Fictitious BPOM number not in the local registry. Must be rejected; a number the verifier has never seen cannot support a fact.

cases.draft_excerpt: Cleansing Foam bersertifikat halal ID9998887776, aman digunakan setiap hari.
cases.notes: Expired halal certificate. The certification claim must be removed or the certificate renewed.

cases.draft_excerpt: FreshGlow Hydra Serum bersertifikat halal ID0123456789.
cases.notes: Active halal certificate. Legitimate certification claim; must not be false-positived.
